known_world_facts: Mara is 18 and works as a apprentice rail investigator.

North Quay operates overnight freight and passenger trains via a small signal network. Dispatch registers are private until released; platform witnesses can be mistaken, and recorded arrivals are not conclusive physical observations.
A witness cannot know a sealed dispatch record before its lawful disclosure.
A stopped pocket watch is not proof that the train stopped in time.
A published manifest is not automatically evidence of physical arrival.
No unverified culprit, sabotage mechanism or secret tunnel becomes canon.
